summary: Preserve that an uninitialized public class field is an own property whose JavaScript value is undefined.

target.notes: Store a JavaScript undefined sentinel (or equivalent tagged value) and ensure the field exists as an own property in object-model operations.

caveats: C# default values such as 0, false, or null are not JavaScript undefined.
Native C# fields do not by themselves provide JavaScript property descriptors.

tests.name: reads undefined
tests.input: class C { x; } console.log(new C().x === undefined);
